record.question: The right of a Government Servant to travelling allowance, including daily allowance is forfeited or deemed to have been relinquished if their claim for it is not preferred within_________ days from the date on which it became due.
record.explanation: The TA claim must be preferred within 60 days of becoming due; otherwise the entitlement is forfeited or deemed relinquished.
